gaps.lead: Although she was exhausted, she carried on working.
gaps.explanation: despite/in spite of + -ing: despite being exhausted.

gaps.lead: I wish I had never told her the secret.
gaps.explanation: wish + past perfect ≈ shouldn't have + participle.

gaps.lead: He began playing chess at the age of six.
gaps.sentence: He ___ at the age of six.
gaps.explanation: take up = start (a hobby or sport): took up chess.

gaps.lead: It would be unwise for you to complain to the manager directly.
gaps.explanation: 'It would be unwise' = 'you had better not' — had better + not + bare infinitive.

gaps.lead: She hates it when people interrupt her.
Somebody needs to renew this passport before June.
gaps.explanation: need + -ing = need to be + participle: needs renewing.
